regions.summary: North Ningxiang (the county seat Yutan and its suburbs) plus the Heshan side of Yiyang and western Wangcheng.

candidates.name: Ningxiang
candidates.meaning: "Peaceful countryside": Tang name of 627 for the county, renamed from Xinkang.
candidates.fit: Holds the county seat (Yutan, seat since 977) and 57% of the region's people; the region has 40% of the county, region 10 has 59%.
candidates.source_note: 唐贞观元年（627年）取乡土安宁之意，改新康县为“宁乡县”，宋兴国二年（977年）县治移至玉潭镇

candidates.name: Heshan
candidates.meaning: Named after the Heshan temple; Heshan district of Yiyang, created in 1994.
candidates.fit: 30% of the region's people but only a modern district name from the Yiyang side; Yiyang agents may use it.
candidates.source_note: 赫山区因区内有闻名的“赫山庙”而得名

regions.notes: Ningxiang is split between regions 1 and 10; I gave it to 1 because the seat is there. If Anita prefers it for 10, region 1 has no strong alternative (Yutan has no article of its own).

regions.summary: Northeast Changsha county (Huanghua, Jiangbei, Chunhua) and the Liuyang towns on the Laodao River.

candidates.name: Laodao
candidates.meaning: "Fish out the knife": legend says Guan Yu dropped his sword in the river and it floated.
candidates.fit: The 141 km river runs through Liuyang's Shegang, Longfu, Shashi, Beisheng and Yong'an and Changsha county's Chunhua and Huanghua, which are most of this region's towns.
candidates.recognisability: Own zh-wiki article; 80 hits with 湖南, top ones about the river's railway station and Kaifu district.
candidates.source_note: 发源于浏阳市社港镇…流经浏阳市社港镇、龙伏乡、沙市镇、北盛镇和永安镇，长沙县春华镇和黄华镇

candidates.name: Huanghua
candidates.meaning: "Yellow flower": the township holding Changsha Huanghua airport.
candidates.fit: Huanghua town is the largest part (15% of the region).
candidates.recognisability: 669 hits with 湖南, mostly about the airport; known through the airport name.
candidates.source_note: 位于中国湖南省长沙市长沙县黄花镇的国际机场

candidates.name: Changsha county
candidates.meaning: County of Changsha; 52% of the region's people.
candidates.fit: Name is going to the central region 5.
candidates.source_note: 县人民政府驻星沙街道

regions.notes: Liuyang (45% of people) is the settled name of region 6, so it cannot be reused.

regions.summary: Xingsha, the Changsha county seat, with the Liuyang River district of Kaifu and east Furong.

candidates.name: Xingsha
candidates.meaning: "Star sand": the seat of Changsha county; the source of Changsha's nickname Star City (Xingcheng).
candidates.fit: Xingsha subdistrict is the largest part of the region (21%) and Changsha county is 56% of the people.
candidates.recognisability: Seat of Changsha county (zh-wiki county article names it as seat); simplemaps lists it as a 277k city.
candidates.source_note: 县人民政府驻星沙街道

regions.notes: Small dense region, 324k people, at the edge of the Changsha core.

regions.summary: Northern Yuelu district (Yinpenling, Wangyue, Guanshaling) and southern Wangcheng (Gaotangling, Moon Island).

candidates.name: Wangcheng
candidates.meaning: "Watch the city": named for Wangcheng slope, where the county seat sat in 1951.
candidates.fit: Holds 55% of the Wangcheng district's people and the seat (Gaotangling); 35% of this region's people.
candidates.source_note: 因驻地望城坡得名“望城县”；区人民政府驻高塘岭街道

candidates.name: Yuelu
candidates.meaning: Yuelu Mountain, 300 m, on the west bank of the Xiang.
candidates.fit: Yuelu district is 64% of this region's people, but the mountain and the district's core lie in region 7, which should take the name.
candidates.source_note: 岳麓山伫立于湘江西岸（长沙市条目）

regions.notes: Wangcheng also has 13% of region 1, a lesser share.

regions.summary: The old city of Changsha: Furong, south Kaifu, parts of Tianxin and Yuhua, with the seat of Tanzhou and Changsha prefecture.

candidates.name: Changsha
candidates.meaning: "Long sands": name first recorded in the pre-Qin Yi Zhou Shu, for the sandbars of the Xiang River.
candidates.fit: Holds the old centre and the seat of Changsha commandery, kingdom and prefecture; over a million people.
candidates.source_note: “长沙”一名最早见于先秦时代的《逸周书》

regions.notes: Only the central region gets Changsha, per the brief.

regions.summary: Yuelu district west of the Xiang: Yuelu Mountain, Orange Isle, Xihu, Meixi Lake.

candidates.name: Yuelu
candidates.meaning: Yuelu Mountain, 300 m, on the west bank of the Xiang; seat of the Song academy.
candidates.fit: Yuelu district is 99.8% of the region; the mountain, Yuelu Academy and Orange Isle are inside.
candidates.recognisability: Famous: Yuelu Academy is one of the four great Song academies.
candidates.source_note: 岳麓山伫立于湘江西岸；岳麓书院为宋代四大书院之一（长沙市条目）

regions.summary: Yuhua district south-east of the old city: Gaoqiao, Yuhuating, Lituo, Dongtang.

candidates.name: Yuhua
candidates.meaning: "Rain flower": named for the Yuhua pavilion (Yuhuating).
candidates.fit: Yuhua district is 87% of the region's people (65% of the district).
candidates.recognisability: Current district; named in zh-wiki for Yuhuating.
candidates.source_note: 因雨花亭而得名

regions.notes: Adjacent regions 3, 7, 9 are also named after districts or towns; I found no better well-sourced alternatives for these small city regions.

regions.summary: Tianxin district south of the old city, with Muyun and the Tongsheng part of Yuhua.

candidates.name: Tianxin
candidates.meaning: "Heart of heaven": named for the Tianxin Pavilion on the old city wall.
candidates.fit: Tianxin district is 71% of the region's people (78% of the district).
candidates.source_note: 天心区为湖南省长沙市市辖区，位于长沙城区的南部

regions.notes: The pavilion meaning is not in the sources.md extract; check if Anita wants it stated.

regions.summary: South and west Ningxiang plus Shaoshan and the western edge of Xiangtan (Yuhu, Xiangtan county, Xiangxiang).

candidates.name: Shaoshan
candidates.meaning: Named after Shaoshan hill; the town where Mao Zedong was born.
candidates.fit: The whole city (cover 100%) is here, 9% of the people; Ningxiang itself (63%) goes to region 1.
candidates.source_note: 湘潭市县级市；1968年析出韶山区建省属韶山特区（湘潭县条目）

candidates.name: Ningxiang
candidates.meaning: "Peaceful countryside".
candidates.fit: 63% of this region's people and 59% of the county, but the seat is in region 1.
candidates.source_note: 宁乡市地理描述

regions.notes: Xinkang (the Jin county seated at Hengshi here) has no zh-wiki article and weak hits; Huangcai (4%) has no article. Shaoshan is a modest fit; the region is mostly rural Ningxiang.

regions.summary: Xiangtan city centre on both banks of the Xiang: Yuhu and Yuetang districts.

candidates.name: Xiangtan
candidates.meaning: "Xiang pool": the deep pool (Zhaotan) in the Xiang River below Zhao Mountain, or the deep, broad land of the Xiang.
candidates.fit: Holds the old seat of Xiangtan county and Xiangtan prefecture (Song to Qing); both urban districts.
candidates.source_note: “湘潭”之名来源于它的地理特征…昭潭

regions.summary: Zhuzhou city centre on the east bank of the Xiang: Shifeng, Lusong, Hetang districts.

candidates.name: Zhuzhou
candidates.meaning: "Tree-stump island": from Zhutian village or from chu trees; named in 1190.
candidates.fit: Holds the urban core of the prefecture (railway city, Lusong market); Zhuzhou's old name Jianning also had a seat here (222-270).
candidates.source_note: 自南宋绍熙元年（1190年）正式定名株洲后，株洲之名沿用至今

regions.notes: Zhuzhou is the central region of a city well over 1M (with Tianyuan in region 13).

regions.summary: South Zhuzhou (Tianyuan, Lukou) and the east of Xiangtan county around Yisuhe.

candidates.name: Lukou
candidates.meaning: "Mouth of the Lu River": where the Lu River enters the Xiang.
candidates.fit: Former Zhuzhou county (seat Lukou), 27% of the region plus Tianyuan; Lukou district is the former county.
candidates.source_note: 渌口区人民政府驻渌口镇；2018年撤销株洲县设立渌口区

candidates.name: Xiangtan county
candidates.meaning: Xiangtan county, seat Yisuhe.
candidates.fit: 40% of the region's people and its seat (Yisuhe, 12%), but the name Xiangtan goes to region 11.
candidates.source_note: 县政府驻易俗河镇

regions.notes: Weak region: a Zhuzhou-Xiangtan boundary mix. Han Xiangnan county and Hengyang commandery had seats in Xiangtan county here, but Hengyang is a famous different place.

regions.summary: Liling city plus Xiangdong district of Pingxiang.
Xiangxiang city and the western half of Xiangtan county, with a part of Zhuzhou county.

candidates.name: Xiangxiang
candidates.meaning: "Marquisate of Xiang": from the Xiangxiang marquis enfeoffed in the Western Han.
candidates.fit: Xiangxiang is 50% of the region and the seat of the old county is inside (county since AD 9); the region holds 77% of the city.
candidates.source_note: 湘乡的名字来源于西汉时所封的湘乡侯

candidates.name: Xiangtan county
candidates.meaning: Xiangtan county.
candidates.fit: 36% of the region's people, but the name Xiangtan goes to region 11.
candidates.source_note: 县政府驻易俗河镇

regions.notes: Xiangxiang and Xiangtan look alike; they are different places, no repeated characters.
The label on the map reads "you shui", which looks like a typo for Youxian; not my call to change.

regions.summary: Chaling county, with Anren and Yanling.
